open-crafter.config.title: Open Crafter
open-crafter.config.hand_view.desc: First-person hand and held item tweaks. Purely visual: nothing sent to the server changes.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.enabled.de: Global toggle for Hand View. When off, every setting in this tab is ignored and the hands render as in vanilla.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.general.de: How the hands follow the camera and which hands show.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.server_rot: Makes your hands follow the rotation last sent to the server, while another mod spoofs it.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.no_rotatio: Keeps your hands fixed to the camera instead of lagging behind when you turn.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.hide_empty: Does not render your bare hand when holding nothing.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.skip_swapp: Shows a newly held item at once instead of lowering and raising the hand.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.remove_ski: Draws your arm with the slim default skin (Alex) instead of your own, so it looks the same for every player.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.swing.desc: How swings caused by clicks look.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.swing.left:
The animation of a swing caused by a left click (attacking, mining).
Vanilla: the usual full swing.
Stub: a short jab to 3–5 % of the swing that trembles there while the button is held, and eases back when released.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.swing.righ:
The animation of a swing caused by a right click.
Vanilla: the usual swing and re-equip dip.
Smooth: food moves from where the hand already is to the middle; a placed block's item reaches out to where the block lands; using an entity or block shakes the hand until the button is released.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.swing.old_: Hit animations like 1.8: the main hand stays raised after an attack instead of following the attack cooldown.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.swing.swin: Forces every swing of yours to show in the chosen hand. The swing the server sees is unchanged.
Ticks a first-person swing lasts (vanilla: 6). Lower is faster.
Scale, position and rotation of the item in your main hand.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.off_hand.d: Scale, position and rotation of the item in your off hand.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.arm.desc: Scale, position and rotation of your bare arm.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.scale.x.de: Size factor along the axis (1 is vanilla).
open-crafter.config.hand_view.scale.y.de: Size factor along the axis (1 is vanilla).
open-crafter.config.hand_view.scale.z.de: Size factor along the axis (1 is vanilla).
open-crafter.config.hand_view.position.x: Offset along the axis, in blocks.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.position.y: Offset along the axis, in blocks.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.position.z: Offset along the axis, in blocks.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.rotation.x: Rotation about the axis, in degrees.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.rotation.y: Rotation about the axis, in degrees.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.rotation.z: Rotation about the axis, in degrees.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.eating.dis: Keeps the food where it is held instead of moving it to the middle. Potentially desirable if it goes off screen.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.eating.off: Offset of the eating/drinking pose, in blocks. X is right.
Offset of the eating/drinking pose, in blocks. Y is up.
Offset of the eating/drinking pose, in blocks. Z is towards you.
open-crafter.config.hand_view.eating.sca: Size of the food or potion while it is eaten (1 is vanilla).
open-crafter.config.hand_view.eating.bob: How much the eating/drinking pose bobs, relative to vanilla.
open-crafter.config.inventory_view.desc: Animations of inventory screens. Purely visual: what the screens do is unchanged.
open-crafter.config.inventory_view.backp: The player inventory, opened with the inventory key instead of by using a block.
The backpack flies in from the bottom of the screen to the centre when opened, and flies back down when closed. The game takes your input again as soon as it closes.
Ticks the backpack takes to fly in when opened (20 ticks are one second). Lower is faster.
Ticks the backpack takes to fly back down when closed (20 ticks are one second). Lower is faster.
open-crafter.config.gaze.desc: The rendered camera looks where the body acts. Purely visual: the player's rotation, input and what is sent to the server are unchanged.
open-crafter.config.gaze.enabled.desc: Global toggle for Gaze. When off, the camera renders as in vanilla. Off by default: whether frames should show this is an open research choice.
open-crafter.config.gaze.sources.desc: Other mods often act on targets away from the crosshair. These make that visible in the first-person view.
open-crafter.config.gaze.follow_server_a: While another mod sends the server a different rotation than yours (silent rotations), the camera turns to it. When both agree, the camera is your own.
open-crafter.config.gaze.look_at_actions: When a mod acts on something off the crosshair without rotating at all, the camera turns toward the point it acts on, holds through the action and turns back.
open-crafter.config.gaze.timing.desc: Wall-clock durations in milliseconds. A new target during a turn redirects it smoothly.
Roughly how long the camera takes to turn onto a target (ms).
open-crafter.config.gaze.hold_millis.des: How long the camera stays on a target after the action's outcome, or after the server rotation was last spoofed (ms).
open-crafter.config.gaze.ease_out_millis: Roughly how long the camera takes to turn back to your own rotation (ms).
open-crafter.config.contact.desc: An action's consequence shown where it happened, over a few frames instead of in one, and only when the world really had it. Works for every action, whoever sent it (keyboard, the backend, another mod). Purely visual.
open-crafter.config.contact.crack.desc: Cracks on a block while it is being broken.
open-crafter.config.contact.crack.enable: A break another mod or the backend drives (also with raw packets) cracks the block like a keyboard break, at the game's rate for that block and the held tool.
open-crafter.config.contact.crack.linger: Ticks the cracks stay at their last stage once the block should have broken, waiting for the break to finish (20 ticks are one second).
open-crafter.config.contact.shrink.desc: What a block does when a break removes it.
open-crafter.config.contact.shrink.enabl: The broken block shrinks to its centre instead of vanishing in one frame.
open-crafter.config.contact.shrink.ticks: Ticks the block takes to shrink away (20 ticks are one second).
open-crafter.config.contact.hinge.desc: Doors, trapdoors, fence gates, levers and buttons switched by using them.
open-crafter.config.contact.hinge.enable: The door, gate wing or lever handle swings to its new state (a button slides in) instead of snapping.
Ticks the swing takes (20 ticks are one second).
open-crafter.config.contact.push.desc: What a mob or player does when a hit hurts it.
open-crafter.config.contact.push.enabled: The hit entity is drawn pushed a little away from where it was hit, and comes back. Only its picture moves, never the entity.
open-crafter.config.contact.push.ticks.d: Ticks the push out and back takes (20 ticks are one second).
How far the push goes, in blocks (0.06 is about one pixel of a block's texture).
open-crafter.config.vision.desc: The vision sensor: frames pushed to connected backends.
open-crafter.config.vision.rate.desc: How often frames are pushed. Backends can also change it (vision.set_rate).
open-crafter.config.vision.rate_mode.des:
Tick: one frame per client tick.
Fixed Hz: a fixed frequency.
Max FPS: every rendered frame.
open-crafter.config.vision.fixed_hz.desc: Frames per second in Fixed Hz mode.
open-crafter.config.vision.status.desc: The vision sensor as it was when this screen opened.
open-crafter.config.input.desc: Keys and clicks held by backends.
open-crafter.config.input.holds.desc: Bounds on simulated key holds, so nothing stays stuck.
A held key is released if the backend does not re-assert it within this time.
open-crafter.config.input.max_hold_ms.de: Upper bound for any single hold (duration_ms, lease_ms).
open-crafter.config.transport.desc: Where backends connect. Saving a change here reopens the transport, so connected backends reconnect.
open-crafter.config.transport.channel.de: The control socket and the shared frame ring.
open-crafter.config.transport.listen.des:
Auto: TCP on loopback on Windows, a Unix domain socket elsewhere.
Unix: a Unix domain socket.
TCP: loopback TCP with a token.
open-crafter.config.transport.socket_pat: Unix socket file. Empty: inside the discovery directory.
open-crafter.config.transport.tcp_port.d: Loopback TCP port. 0: any free port (announced in the discovery file).
open-crafter.config.transport.shm_path.d: Frame ring file. Empty: /dev/shm on Linux, else the discovery directory.
open-crafter.config.transport.auth.desc: The token TCP backends present. A Unix socket needs none.
open-crafter.config.transport.token.desc: Empty: a new random token every launch. Note that this field is visible on screen, and so in the vision stream.
open-crafter.config.transport.copy_token: Copies the token in use to the clipboard without showing it. Only available while listening on TCP.
open-crafter.config.transport.status.des: The transport as it was when this screen opened.
